79566.subject: Tokenization Briefing: Fed Raises Rate & Stablecoins Rake in Money
79566.body:
The Tokenization Briefing newsletter keeps you up to date with market insights and visual analyses on what matters in the world of tokenized assets

( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters )

GM. The Fed raised rates for the first time since July 2023 last Wednesday, with futures implying an additional 75bp rate increase through mid-2027. Besides its broader effect on financial markets, higher rates should drive more demand for tokenized treasuries while increasing the opportunity cost of holding idle stablecoins in the wake of the GENIUS Act’s yield ban.

In today’s issue, we cover the OCC and FDIC moving to tighten stablecoin yield restrictions, the SEC’s Innovation Exemption allowing a controlled environment for permissioned platforms to trade tokenized stocks in the U.S., and real-world assets accounting for roughly half of Hyperliquid’s perp markets by volume.

Thanks for subscribing!

*Top of Mind*

*The Fed Raises Rates and What It Means for Stablecoins*

The Fed increased its benchmark rate by 25bp to reach a 3.75% - 4% target range on September 16, with 16 of 18 FOMC participants expecting at least one more rate hike this year. Hikes are expected to continue until the Fed reaches a target range of 4.5% - 4.75% in mid-2027, in an attempt to cool stubbornly high inflation.

At a roughly $310B stablecoin market cap and a 4% rate on treasuries, holders are on pace to collectively forgo $12B per year in stablecoin yield to issuers like Circle and Tether, with each 25bp increase adding another $775 million in opportunity cost.

This dynamic led to rapid growth in tokenized treasuries, with a series of rate hikes in 2022 and 2023 preceding a $14 billion increase in market cap, rising from under 0.5% to over 5% of the total stablecoin value.

This rising opportunity cost and growth of tokenized treasuries was compounded by the stablecoin yield ban introduced by the GENIUS Act on July 18, 2025. GENIUS made it illegal for issuers to pass yield back to stablecoin holders.
To circumvent the ban, stablecoin issuers started routing yield back to holders via affiliates, positioning the payouts as rewards instead of direct payouts from the issuer:

* Coinbase pays USDC holders 3.5% APY, positioned as loyalty rewards, arguing that non-issuers distributing rewards fall outside the ban.
* PayPal offers 3.7% on PYUSD, promoted as a loyalty reward.
* Kraken pays USDG holders via its "Global Dollar Rewards" program.

In response, the OCC and FDIC proposed rules that treat indirect payouts as violations of the ban. With the GENIUS Act scheduled to take effect in Jan 2027, this should drive increased demand for tokenized treasuries.

Although stablecoins retain many structural advantages over tokenized treasuries, including better composability and frictionless retail access, we’ll likely see stablecoin issuers increasingly enter the tokenized treasury market as a hedge.

79564.subject: Your exchange's numbers might not be real. Here's how to check.
79564.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5050aa72-b7aa-4e80-b460-95bac07cacb0/Top_Thorchain.jpg?t=1790090559)
Follow image link: (https://swap.thorchain.org/?ref=5y4envw2xkrl)
Caption: 

Welcome to the DefiLlama Newsletter. This week, along with the deepest onchain dataset on Earth, we’re covering RWA trading growth, the best way to find a new exchange, and more.

## Stablecoins see highest inflow day in over a year

See today’s inflows (https://defillama.com/stablecoins?chartType=inflows)

In October 2025, total stablecoin market cap crossed $300b, capping off an incredible year for stablecoin growth, with $100b stablecoins added onchain.

Stablecoins saw 10 straight months of inflows, most of which were over $5b.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/693a935c-6339-4e57-8534-a563f8f47523/stablecoins-inflows-usd_2026-09-22.png?t=1790042691)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/stablecoins?chartType=inflows&groupBy=monthly)
Caption: 

Here we are today - nearly a year from October 2025 and stablecoin market cap has grown *_checks notes_* 2%.

Volume is higher - [stablecoin volume in 2026 has already surpassed 2025](https://defillama.com/stablecoins?groupBy=yearly&chartType=volume) with a quarter of the year left. H1 2026 volume nearly doubled from the same period in 2025.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0a0b41c1-1f5d-4f97-8dc5-9032f62408c5/stablecoins-volume-total_2026-09-22.png?t=1790042682)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/stablecoins?chartType=volume&groupBy=monthly)
Caption: 

Over the last month, Ethena’s USDe has been a standout gainer in market cap, growing 20% and adding close to $1b.

Overnight, USDC added $1.2b. This is the largest single-day inflow in over a year. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/91f783f9-2fdc-488e-9542-9566295ecd0b/image.png?t=1790083016)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/stablecoins?chartType=inflows&chartView=token)
Caption: 

Most of this was [added to Solana](https://defillama.com/stablecoins/solana), the rest to [Hyperliquid](https://defillama.com/stablecoins/hyperliquid-l1).

While stablecoin market cap has been mostly flat over the last year, RWA AUM is anything but: up 250% over the last year.

Growth in RWA perps is even larger. RWA Perps Open Interest is up 25% over the last month, and a whopping 7,000% YTD.
